priorityList: Use Charge to engage or close gaps.
Use Recklessness and Avatar on cooldown, ideally together.
Cast Rampage if Rage is above 100 or if Enrage is about to expire.
Cast Thunder Blast if you have 2 stacks of the Thunder Blast buff.
Cast Rampage while Recklessness is active.
Cast Thunder Blast while Avatar is active.
Cast Execute whenever it is available.
Cast Thunder Blast whenever it is available.
Cast Thunder Clap if no other abilities are available.
